title: Resident doctors at Government Medical College in Srinagar go on indefinite strike
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — INDIA
key_facts: The union has begun a strike at Kashmir College, affecting transport services.
The union said long-pending issues behind the strike were raised with the government.
The union has asked the government for talks and a written resolution.
